answer: Sybil resistance can be built as a work-bonded ledger. Every identity must post a compact log of tasks and results; peers countersign only what they can independently verify, and unsigned logs collect no emission. A new swarm may invent a fable of prior labor, yet that story has no pigment from earlier seals and cannot tint the payout set. Over a cool-down window the protocol also demands a pulse of distinct attestors. Cloning wallets therefore multiplies empty logs, not votes or rewards, because influence follows corroborated work rather than names.
